rules: Closed candles only; higher timeframe values become available only after their close; signal at 15m close, fill next 15m open; long-only spot; 3x 15m ATR stop; RSI>=70 or 96-bar time stop; one position; 0.1% fee and 0.05% slippage per side.
antiLookahead: Higher timeframe alignment requires source open_time + interval duration <= execution candle close. Divergence is emitted only after two right-side candles confirm the pivot.
